blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A tip from a concerned citizen led to the discovery of an alleged drug den in Barangay Tangke, Talisay City, and a subsequent buy-bust operation on Saturday night, November 7. The operation resulted in the arrest of three individuals believed to be operating the alleged drug den. The buy-bust operation followed […]...
